title: Identity Validation Scorecard — Resolution, Targeting, and S320-Class Prevention
authority: SESSION350_V1_BASELINE.json (Board A); SESSION321_IDENTITY_SCHEMA_V2.json; SESSION201_IDENTITY_ARCHITECTURE.json; scripts/output/identity_validation_report.json (S322 operational snapshot)
purpose: Measure identity resolution effectiveness. The v1 QID-only model caused DL-029 phantom defects (~75% false-positive rate), S320 wrong-variant remediation, and ~12 phantom QIDs. The v2 compound-key model must eliminate identity ambiguity entirely — validated through these metrics.

v1_model.label: Framework v1 — QID-Only Identity
v1_model.description: Items identified solely by QuestionID string (e.g., 'P1-AD-001'). This model fails because one QID represents a template group, not a unique item. Rotations within the group (A→B→C→D→A) have different CorrectChoice values but share the same QID.

failures.impact: Forward-scan tools used QID to locate CC — in Pack B, CC appears BEFORE QID, producing 100% false-positive defect reports. 257 Pack B DL-008 false positives. ~8 sessions wasted on phantom investigation.
S320 attempted to remediate template rotation items but targeted wrong variants because QID-first-match doesn't guarantee matching the canonical seed.
Same QID suffix (e.g., 'A.001') appears across Packs A, C, D. QID-only tools cannot distinguish which pack's item is being referenced.
~12 phantom QIDs documented — items that don't actually exist but were referenced in defect reports due to parsing errors.
DL-016 metadata offset: ExplanationWrong fields describe the wrong choice because the choice-to-explanation mapping shifted by +1 in certain blocks.

v2_model.label: Framework v2 — 6-Field Compound Key Identity

fields.purpose: Base template group identifier. Not globally unique.
Distinguishes rotation positions within a template group.
Binary fingerprint of distractor slot emptiness. Most reliable structural identifier.
Rotation group identifier — items sharing same stem skeleton + choice texts.
Source pack file path. Resolves cross-pack QID collisions.
Content hash truncated. Tracks revision history.

v2_model.extraction_methodology: AM-1 Within-Object Function Constructor Parse ONLY. Forward-scan from QID is FORBIDDEN (produces DL-029 artifacts). Governance guard Rules 9-10 enforce at HARD_BLOCK level (FM-001 through FM-008 forbidden methodologies).

IM-001_identity_resolution_rate.description: Percentage of items for which a valid, unique compound key can be computed from within-object extracted fields.
valid_compound_key_conditions: EWPattern is a valid 4-bit binary string where CC bit = 0
TemplateFamily resolves to an existing family or is classified as UNGROUPED
FilePath is a valid pack file path
VersionID is a valid content hash prefix
IM-001_identity_resolution_rate.v2_target: 100% (every item must have a valid compound key)
IM-001_identity_resolution_rate.current_s322: 2,539 of 2,540 (99.96%) — 1 item in Pack D with empty CorrectChoice could not resolve

IM-002_variant_resolution_rate.description: Percentage of rotation-group variants correctly disambiguated. Two items with same QID but different CC should be recognized as distinct items, not the same item.
IM-002_variant_resolution_rate.correct_disambiguation: Compound key mechanism: QID+CC uniquely identifies every rotation variant within a TemplateFamily. Two items with same QID+CC across different files are still distinct via FilePath field.
IM-002_variant_resolution_rate.v1_baseline: ~0% (QID-only model treated all variants as single item — the root cause of S320 wrong-variant remediation)
IM-002_variant_resolution_rate.v2_target: 100% (every rotation variant must have a unique compound key)
IM-002_variant_resolution_rate.current_s322: Not yet measured — requires TemplateFamily computation on all 2,540 items

IM-003_targeting_accuracy.description: Percentage of remediation/defect operations that target the correct item. In v1, DL-029 false positives meant agents were 'fixing' the wrong item's CC because QID-forward-scan grabbed the neighbor's value.
IM-003_targeting_accuracy.verification_method: Post-operation: verify the item's compound key matches the target key. Any mismatch = targeting failure.
IM-003_targeting_accuracy.v1_baseline: ~25% (DL-029 ~75% false-positive rate on Pack B CC-before-QID scans)
IM-003_targeting_accuracy.v2_target: 100% (compound key + AM-1 within-object extraction eliminates forward-scan targeting errors)
protections: FM-001: Forward-scan from QID FORBIDDEN — governance guard Rule 9 HARD_BLOCK
FM-004: QID-only resolution FORBIDDEN — governance guard Rule 10 HARD_BLOCK
AM-1: Function Constructor Parse is the ONLY approved extraction method
Gate -1 GV-N1-08: Pack B CC extraction verified — CC field location validated before any downstream operation

IM-004_false_identification_rate.description: Rate at which identity operations misidentify an item — e.g., reading QID 'P1-AD-001' but extracting CC from a different object in the file (forward-scan artifact).
IM-004_false_identification_rate.v1_baseline: ~75% on Pack B scans (DL-029: CC-before-QID ordering produced 100% false positives on all Pack B forward-scan tools)
IM-004_false_identification_rate.v2_target: 0% (AM-1 within-object extraction guarantees CC belongs to its co-resident QID)
IM-004_false_identification_rate.current_s322: 0 false identifications from AM-1 parse — all 2,539 passing items have internally consistent QID+CC pairing

IM-005_cross_pack_collision_rate.description: Rate at which QID-only identity would confuse items from different packs. The compound key resolves this via FilePath field.
known_collisions: Suffix 'A.001' through 'A.100' appear in Packs A, C, D
Suffix 'B.001' through 'B.100' appear in Packs A, C, D
Suffix 'E.001' through 'E.100' appear in Packs A, C, D
IM-005_cross_pack_collision_rate.v1_baseline: UNMEASURED (QID-only tools had no mechanism to detect or resolve collisions)
IM-005_cross_pack_collision_rate.v2_target: 0 unidentified collisions — FilePath field in compound key eliminates all ambiguity

IM-006_compound_key_stability.description: Percentage of compound keys that remain stable (unchanged) across independent AM-1 passes on the same pack file. Key instability indicates non-deterministic extraction.
IM-006_compound_key_stability.v2_target: 100% (same pack file, same AM-1 parse, same compound key — every time)
IM-006_compound_key_stability.verification: Run identity_validator.js twice on the same pack files. Compare compound keys. Any difference = extraction bug.

s320_class_prevention.label: S320-Class Failure Prevention
s320_class_prevention.description: S320 attempted remediation of template rotation items but targeted wrong variants because QID-first-match doesn't guarantee matching the canonical seed. Framework v2 prevents this class of failure through three mechanisms.

prevention_mechanisms.description: Every remediation operation targets items by compound key (QID|CC|EWP|TF|FP|VID), not by QID alone. The compound key uniquely identifies the exact item variant — no wrong-variant risk.
Every item's compound key is validated before any downstream operation. Wrong-variant items would be flagged at Gate -1 with IDENTITY_BLOCKED.

All item fields are extracted via Function Constructor parse on the item's own question object. No forward-scan, no regex-window, no QID-first-match. The CC field is guaranteed to belong to its co-resident QID.

forbidden_methodologies: FM-001: Forward scan from QID (positional scan outward from regex match) — HARD_BLOCK Rule 9
FM-002: Regex-window extraction (regex capture group without within-object parse) — HARD_BLOCK Rule 9
FM-003: QID-first-match (find first QID match, assume adjacent CC belongs to it) — HARD_BLOCK Rule 10
FM-004: QID-only item resolution (resolve item identity without compound key) — HARD_BLOCK Rule 10
FM-005: Cross-object field assumption (assume field X from object N belongs to object N+1) — HARD_BLOCK Rule 9
FM-006: Line-number-based extraction (extract by line number, not by within-object parse) — HARD_BLOCK Rule 9
FM-007: String-index offset extraction (indexOf QID + offset to find CC) — HARD_BLOCK Rule 9
FM-008: Non-Function-Constructor parse (JSON.parse, eval, regex-based) — HARD_BLOCK Rule 9

trend_tracking.baseline_v1: 0% compound key resolution (did not exist); ~25% targeting accuracy on QID-only model
